1978-2392-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.

4419-4694-6798-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4419-4694-6798-7306.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat from step 1.

687-2034-5902-8130.easyPrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a creature you control.
687-2034-5902-8130.description:
Activate Wall of Roots by putting two -0/-1 counters on it (due to Innkeeper's Talent), adding {G}.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control.
In response to Tayam's ability, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wall of Roots, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling yourself three cards and returning Wall of Roots from your graveyard to the battlefield with two vigilance counters on it due to Tayam and Innkeeper's Talent.
Repeat.
687-2034-5902-8130.notes: This order of operations and the {2} starting mana are necessary because you cannot pay the counter removal cost before sacrificing the creature to Ashnod's Altar, due to the timing sequence of the activated ability rules.

2556-7694-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2556-7694-8043.description:
Cast Multiversal Incursion for free due to Vision, creating a nonlegendary token copy of each nontoken creature you control.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters, it triggers, returning Multiversal Incursion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

620-1429-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2511-6854--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2511-6854--5--195.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Host of the Hereafter trigger.
Resolve Host of the Hereafter's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

654-851-4094-4365-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
654-851-4094-4365-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

864-4872-7370.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Eternal Witness.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Eternal Witness from exile to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1563-6968-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
1563-6968-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
1563-6968-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

4302-4509-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another Angel.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-5319-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
997-5319-6972.notes: If Geralf's Messenger starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

2617-2963-7150.easyPrerequisites: You haven't activated Kirol's ability this turn.
2617-2963-7150.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and Midnight Guard. copying Teleportation Circle's trigger, targeting Kirol.
Resolve the copy of Teleportation Circle's trigger, blinking Kirol.
When Kirol enters, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping Midnight Guard.
Repeat from step 2.

206-560-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

1329-5330-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1329-5330-7340.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard this turn.
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-1858-2056-4460.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-1858-2056-4460.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

1402-2644-4763-7296.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4365-4682-5140-6441.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
4365-4682-5140-6441.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Mondrak and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
4365-4682-5140-6441.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

2366-4927-4974-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4927-4974-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zendikar Resurgent triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2957-3767-3918-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
2957-3767-3918-7013.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-6608-6709.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
3532-5078-6608-6709.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3054-3416-5670-5870.easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
3054-3416-5670-5870.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Guide of Souls triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life and get {E}{E}.
Activate Warren Soultrader twice by paying 2 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire and the Vampire token, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1003-2173-3967-5220.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3490-4659-5572-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
3490-4659-5572-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1603-5299-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Evil Twin
1603-5299-5466.description:
Cast Evil Twin by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Evil Twin into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Evil Twin's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Evil Twin's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Evil Twin's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

288-560-3000-4050.description:
Activate Oketra by paying {3}{W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier, two 1/1 Squirrel and a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing the Squirrels, Soldier and Warrior, adding {3}{W}.
Repeat.

539-4693-5649-6517.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2919-2999-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-2999-4186.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

586-997-4924-5258-5618.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2292-4871-5626-6415.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Wriggling Grub from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Wriggling Grub.
When Wriggling Grub dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Wriggling Grub trigger, creating two 1/1 Worm creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

147-618-5940.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nonlegendary creature.
147-618-5940.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting any nonlegendary creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying {1}{R}{R}, choosing its first mode, targeting Kiki-Jiki's ability.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Return the Favor, targeting Kiki-Jiki's ability.
Resolve the copy of Return the Favor, copying Kiki-Jiki's ability, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Kiki-Jiki's ability, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage  with haste.
Repeat from step 4.

276-791-3231-3693.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
276-791-3231-3693.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

624-3967-5011.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

313-413-914.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
313-413-914.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station triggers.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least five Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

215-380-2397-5130.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
215-380-2397-5130.description:
Cast Realm-Scorcher Hellkite by paying {4}{R}{R} and sacrificing another artifact, enchantment or token.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it and Miirym trigger twice.
Resolve both Realm-Scorcher Hellkite triggers, adding {5}{R}{R}{G}.
Resolve both Miirym triggers, creating two token copies of Realm-Scorcher Hellkite.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Realm-Scorcher Hellkite to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

904-3090-4126.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying {2}{R}, giving an opponent control of Nefarious Lich.
Activate Despotic Scepter by tapping it, destroying Nefarious Lich.
When Nefarious Lich leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing its controller to lose the game.

148-1525-4298-4651.notablePrerequisites:
Phyresis and Keen Sense attached to Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
148-1525-4298-4651.description:
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Keen Sense triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

92-2298-2935.notablePrerequisites: Each opponent has a life total that is less than forty.
92-2298-2935.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Activate Ethereal Champion by paying 1 life, preventing the next one damage dealt to it this turn.
Repeat step 2 until you have one life.
Cast Oketra's Last Mercy by paying {1}{W}{W}, causing your life total to become forty.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose thirty-nine life.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
